description: Na₃TbBr₆ is Ilmenite-like structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are two inequivalent Na¹⁺ sites. In the first Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded to six Br¹⁻ atoms to form NaBr₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent TbBr₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 43-47°. There are a spread of Na-Br bond distances ranging from 2.86-3.03 Å. In the second Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven Br¹⁻ atoms. There are a spread of Na-Br bond distances ranging from 2.97-3.65 Å. Tb³⁺ is bonded to six Br¹⁻ atoms to form TbBr₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaBr₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 43-47°. There are a spread of Tb-Br bond distances ranging from 2.78-2.82 Å. There are three inequivalent Br¹⁻ sites. In the first Br¹⁻ site, Br¹⁻ is bonded to three Na¹⁺ and one Tb³⁺ atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing BrNa₃Tb trigonal pyramids. In the second Br¹⁻ site, Br¹⁻ is bonded to three Na¹⁺ and one Tb³⁺ atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing BrNa₃Tb trigonal pyramids. In the third Br¹⁻ site, Br¹⁻ is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four Na¹⁺ and one Tb³⁺ atom.
